create_compute_tensor_info: compute TensorInfo with shape, dtype, stats, and optional sample for a single PyTorch tensor
compare_tensor_pair: compare two PyTorch tensors and return TensorComparisonInfo with diff metrics and shape mismatch detection
compute_tensor_stats: compute TensorStats including mean, abs_mean, std, min, max, and percentiles for a PyTorch tensor
compute_percentiles: compute percentile values at default levels for a PyTorch tensor
compute_diff: compute DiffInfo with rel_diff, max_abs_diff, mean_abs_diff, and per-token rel_diff between two PyTorch tensors
